productAttributes.title: Product characteristics
productAttributes.subtitle: Properties the shop describes its products with: composition, volume, country. The values are filled in on each product.

typeHints.text: Free text: composition, article number, description of the raw material.
typeHints.number: A number with a unit: volume, weight, length. Only a number gets the «from – to» filter.
typeHints.select: A closed list of values: country, flavour, form.
typeHints.boolean: A flag: hypoallergenic, in stock, suitable for children.

preset.none: The standard characteristics are already there

empty.title: No characteristics yet
empty.message: Create the first one or add the standard set of seven: article number, composition, volume, weight, country, shelf life, purpose.

create.title: New characteristic
create.description: The buyer sees the name; the machine name goes into the filter address and the import column. You fill in the values on the products.
create.selectHint: The first value appears at once; add the others on the card.

fields.name: Name
fields.keyCreateHint: Suggested from the name; lowercase Latin letters, digits and underscores. It does not change after the create.
fields.keyLocked: Does not change: filter addresses and import columns are built on it.
fields.unitHint: For example ml, g or cm.
fields.categoryHint: A characteristic tied to a category applies to its subcategories as well.
fields.showOnProductHint: A line in the «Characteristics» block of the product page.
fields.useAsFilterHint: A filter in the catalog. For a number, a «from – to» range.

errors.nameRequired: Enter the name of the characteristic.
errors.keyFormat: Machine name: lowercase Latin letters, digits and underscores, 2 to 40 characters.

translations.title: Name translations
translations.description: The name in the storefront's languages. Left empty, the buyer sees the name in the main language.

values.title: Values
values.description: A closed list: a product carries one of these values. The machine name goes into the filter address, the buyer sees the name.
values.drawerHint: A removed value disappears from the products that carried it; after the save a message says from how many.

errors.empty: A choice list needs at least one value.
errors.incomplete: Every value needs a name and a machine name: lowercase Latin letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
errors.duplicate: The machine names of the values must differ.

delete.title: Delete this characteristic?
delete.description: «{{name}}» is deleted together with its values on every product and its catalog filter. This cannot be undone.
